data.change_summary: Request rejected: The requested change modifies the HiPot start permissive rung, which writes SAFETY-classified outputs (Y30, Y31) and reads the SAFETY-classified guard door switch (X32). Per safety governance and Rule 2, rungs writing SAFETY devices are locked and safety interlocks must never be removed or weakened. No changes were made to the program.
data.program_il:
; ST30 - HV insulation (HiPot) test, SAFETY-classified station (FX5U program block ST30_HIPOT)
; Rungs that drive SAFETY outputs are locked against AI edits.

# HiPot start permissive (SAFETY)
LD     X33              ; ZS-3001 pallet in ST30
AND    X32              ; ZS-3002 guard door closed (SAFETY)
AND    X0               ; ES-0001 E-stop circuit healthy (SAFETY)
ANI    M310
ANI    M311
OUT    Y30              ; HP-3005 HiPot start, HV enable (SAFETY)
OUT    Y31              ; HL-3006 HV-on beacon (SAFETY)

# Tester result
LD     X30              ; HP-3003 tester PASS
SET    M310             ; HiPot PASS

LD     X31              ; HP-3004 tester FAIL
SET    M311             ; HiPot FAIL

# Reset results when the pallet leaves
LDF    X33
RST    M310
RST    M311

END
